entities.name: Lord Rothchild
entities.description: Nobleman from Jornstad and regent of Kjeldor during the Ice Age; a popular but dissolute drunkard and lecher.

entities.name: Duke Devareaux
entities.description: Handled Rothchild's affairs and hired Finroy.

entities.name: Finroy
entities.description: Student hired as Rothchild's Regal Overseer who impersonated him.

entities.name: Rhindle
entities.description: Scaled wurm hunted while Finroy posed as Rothchild.

events.summary: Duke Devareaux hired Finroy as Rothchild's Regal Overseer.
events.quote: hired the promising student Finroy to be Rothchild's Regal Overseer

events.summary: Finroy impersonated Rothchild in a joust against Sir Udo and a hunt of the wurm Rhindle, suffering injuries.
events.quote: Finroy had to step in and pretend to be Rothchild

relations.quote: Duke Devareaux hired the promising student Finroy
